title: Average fill price
context: Support reports wrong average prices on order receipts, and some receipts fail to load at all. The function should return the volume-weighted average price of an order's fills, rounded to 4 decimals. Make every test pass.

points.title: Loop skips the first fill
points.why: The loop starts at index 1, so the first fill is ignored.
points.fix: Iterate over every fill: for (fill in fills).

points.title: Price isn't weighted by quantity
points.why: Adding raw prices gives a plain average, so a 300-share fill counts the same as a 1-share fill.
points.fix: Add price × quantity to the total.

why.kotlin: Kotlin's / on BigDecimal keeps the dividend's scale and rounds HALF_EVEN, so results get 2 decimals instead of 4.
why.java: divide() without a scale throws ArithmeticException when the result doesn't terminate, such as 5 / 3.

points.title: Empty order divides by zero
points.why: With no fills the quantity is 0, so the division throws instead of returning 0.
points.fix: Return BigDecimal.ZERO early when fills is empty.

points.title: Quantity sum can overflow
points.why: Summing many large fills into an Int can overflow silently.
points.fix: Sum into a Long, or into a BigDecimal.
